paper_id: Wang et al. - 2019 - A Two-Stage RPSO-ACS Based Protocol A New Method for Sensor Network Clustering and Routing in Mobil
title: A Two-Stage RPSO-ACS Based Protocol: A New Method for Sensor Network Clustering and Routing in Mobile Computing
motivation: 传感器节点依赖电池供电，能源有限，数据传输能效成为关键问题，直接影响网络寿命
problem_framing: 将网络分为两阶段：聚类头选择+中继路由优化，兼顾节点能效与簇内距离均衡
key_insight: 利用传输能耗曲线的阈值(93.65m)筛选近基站节点直传，避免不必要的聚类开销
method_signature: RPSO选CH + ACS选Relay构成双阶段优化，替代单跳传输与随机聚类
evaluation_criteria: 存活节点数、BS接收数据量、能耗、覆盖率四维对比实验
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: PSO容易陷入局部最优且存在'运动滞后'问题，需引入重采样机制
evidence_for_taste: PSO is still easy to get trapped in local optimum prematurely
some particles might still be far away from the potential optimal position
the routes of CH towards BS are always not the optimal path
makes them easy to die, which increases the load imbalance
nodes far away from BS would die quickly
data would be transmitted with minimal energy consumption
thinking_moves: 通过能耗曲线数学推导确定直传阈值，而非启发式设定
将CH到BS的单跳传输替换为多跳Relay，用ACO求解最优路径
借鉴粒子滤波的重采样思想改造PSO，解决粒子退化问题
从节点位置和能量双维度定义聚类目标函数，平衡簇内距离与能效
借鉴Particle Filter的重采样机制防止PSO粒子退化
cites_own_work: X. Wang, H. Gu, H. Zhang, and H. Chen, 2019
X. Wang, H. Zhang, S. Fan, and H. Gu, 2018
